title: Preserve independent norm verification
status_detail: Created by the human instruction `create these as tasks`. This records a proposed verification-boundary task only; it does not authorize rewriting retained verifier evidence or activating implementation.
objective: Verify that production norm extraction preserves independent recomputation, source-dependency separation, provenance compatibility, and retained numerical evidence across migrated campaigns.
authorized_scope: After separate explicit activation and completion of the production extraction tasks, add explicit dependency and behavior checks proving that independent verifiers do not import or call production norm analyzers.
Retain independent formulas, exact historical runner identities, accepted provenance boundaries, and byte identities of immutable numerical artifacts.
Compare newly authored and retained payloads only through their documented provenance compatibility boundaries.
completion_criteria: Every migrated campaign verifier independently recomputes applicable norm claims and has an enforced dependency boundary.
Historical retained artifacts and accepted-parent packages retain their exact byte identities.
Verification reports distinguish software verification, numerical verification, scientific validation, and uncertainty quantification without overclaiming.
exclusions: Do not deduplicate verifier formulas by importing production implementations.
Do not rerun accepted-parent computation, alter immutable result packages, or rewrite historical provenance.
No scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, protected execution, release, publication, or automatic successor activation is authorized.
